search_space: all 192 elements of the protected-logical identity kernel K192
canonical_signed_lift: same minimum H/S local Clifford representatives and minimum-SWAP physical-qubit permutation compile used by the frozen motion benchmarks

word_metric.u,v: deterministically selected independent generators of the V4 intersection from the second S4 factor
word_metric.selection: sort exact element IDs; u is first nonidentity; v is first element making <u,v> size 4

metrics_to_minimize: zeroth-order weight-2 coherent residual mean norm squared
second-order equal-two-term 276-basis Magnus mean norm squared
b_dominance_rule: an element dominates b iff it is no worse in every listed metric and strictly better in at least one
pareto_rule: exact Pareto dominance only; no scalarization
scope: ideal instantaneous equal-dwell controls through first Magnus correction; no hardware promotion
